acceptanceCriteria: The owner states the helper's purpose, opt-in mechanism and relation to V1-0598.
The question is converted into a scoped ticket or closed as not needed.
body: Context: Go 1.27.1, Darwin arm64, 2026-10-04, origin/main 8a3e3a5b. An opt-in mocha test helper was noted during work, but the repository has no detail on it: git grep for mocha outside docs/build-log finds nothing, and the only related ticket is V1-0598 (Mocha execution has no matching affected-test runner registration), which concerns runner registration, not a helper. Question for the owner: what should the helper do, who opts in, and is it separate from V1-0598? Without an answer this cannot be scoped.
title: Question: scope of the opt-in mocha test helper noted during work
